[DB Instance: Redshift Retail]

SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.order_ts,
    o.order_date,
    o.customer_id,
    o.store_id,
    o.order_status,
    o.order_amount,
    o.discount_amount,
    o.shipping_amount,
    o.item_count
FROM analytics.retail.fact_orders o
WHERE o.order_status <> 'Cancelled'

select	"a12"."customer_id" AS "customer_id",
	"a12"."customer_name" AS "customer_name",
	"a12"."segment" AS "segment",
	"a12"."region" AS "region",
	"a12"."signup_date" AS "signup_date"
from	"analytics"."retail"."dim_customer"	"a12"

select	"a13"."store_id" AS "store_id",
	"a13"."store_name" AS "store_name",
	"a13"."city" AS "city",
	"a13"."state" AS "state",
	"a13"."region" AS "region",
	"a13"."store_type" AS "store_type"
from	"analytics"."retail"."dim_store"	"a13"

select	"a14"."date_key" AS "date_key",
	"a14"."day_of_week" AS "day_of_week",
	"a14"."week_start_monday" AS "week_start_monday",
	"a14"."week_start_sunday" AS "week_start_sunday",
	"a14"."month_start" AS "month_start",
	"a14"."month_name" AS "month_name",
	"a14"."quarter" AS "quarter",
	"a14"."year" AS "year",
	"a14"."fiscal_year" AS "fiscal_year",
	"a14"."fiscal_quarter" AS "fiscal_quarter"
from	"analytics"."retail"."dim_date"	"a14"
